items.placeName: Origin 1982 - Speakeasy bar in The last old house (1982)

facebook.caption:
Tourists walk past this every day. Locals keep it that way.

Origin 1982 - Speakeasy bar in The last old house (1982) on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is pulling 4.9 stars across 622 reviews and almost nobody on the resort strip knows it exists. A preserved 1982 house turned cocktail bar. $15-30 a head. Craft drinks in a space that actually has character.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.

4.8 stars. 789 reviews. One bar on Đường Bạch Đằng that keeps delivering.

Not every spot at that price holds 4.8 across nearly 800 reviews. This one does.

Beach bar drinks for $15-30 a head. On Trần Hưng Đạo strip. With sand under your feet.

Mojito Beach Bar earns 4.4 stars from 86 reviews and it's not hard to see why. Cold drinks, beach vibes, and a price tag that won't wreck your trip budget.

Phu Quoc beach bars can bleed you dry. This one doesn't.

4.8 stars. 222 reviews. A bar sitting right on Bãi Trường.

Fu Bar at Regent Phu Quoc is not an accident. That rating holds because the drinks are cold, the staff are on it, and the setting does the rest.

Sunset here hits different when you're actually IN it, not watching it from your hotel room.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.

facebook.caption:
This place fixes a bad travel day.

Ocean Night Bar on Võ Thị Sáu is a bar and grill sitting at the edge of Phu Quoc's coastline. 4.8 stars across 443 reviews. Grilled food, cold drinks, the ocean doing its thing at night.

No hustle. No upsell. Just the kind of evening you came here for.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
